thread:
sam: Heads up — I'm seeing a reproducible 500 in prod when rehydrating KV cache. To debug I need to capture full request+response bodies for ~200 failing requests. Asking for quick approval for a short-lived capture. Details below.

anita: What fields do you expect to capture? Any PII or tokens? Where would the dumps live and for how long?

sam: Likely freeform prompts and user emails in the body. No raw bearer tokens in bodies but Authorization is present in headers (we normally redact before storage). Plan:
```
capture_config = {
  "capture": true,
  "fields": ["request.body","response.body","headers"],
  "pseudonymize": ["user_id","email"],
  "scrub_headers": ["Authorization"],
  "store": "s3://redwood-temp-debug-2177",
  "ttl": "48h"
}
```
Bucket would be SSE-KMS, access only to an allowlist role. I also plan to hash user_id with a salt from KMS and mask email local-parts.

lucas: Don’t store Authorization at all. If any tokens could appear in body, they must be redacted before storage. Also add an explicit audit entry (who asked, who approved, JIRA). We require server-side encryption with a customer-managed key and a lifecycle rule to delete after TTL.

anita: I can approve conditionally. Requirements:
- Authorization header removed before persist (not just masked)
- Email addresses masked or pseudonymized (e.g., `alice@***.com` or hash)
- user_id -> `sha256(user_id + kms_salt)` with salt retrieved via KMS API (no local salt)
- S3 bucket policy scoped to a temporary IAM role and logged to audit logs
- Post JIRA ticket referencing the request and link to PR that implements the scrub + bucket policy
- No copies to personal machines; access through web console only and only via the allowlisted role
Add the screenshots of the bucket policy and lifecycle rule in the PR.

sam: Will do. I'll open a JIRA and a PR. Quick question: is 48h fine or do we need CISO signoff for >24h?

security-bot: Per policy 3.2 — temporary captures longer than 24h require explicit CISO notification. Automated notifications will be sent if TTL > 24h.

anita: Given this is a targeted debug (200 requests) and you propose strong pseudonymization and short TTL, we can approve up to 48h but I need the PR + JIRA before I mark as approved. Also require a list of who needs access (names).

jess: I can create the temporary IAM role and the bucket with the correct KMS key. Ping me the JIRA ID in this thread and I'll wire the infra. :thumbsup:

sam: Thanks — creating JIRA INF-4321 and will push a PR with the scrub code + bucket policy. Access list: sam, lucas, jess, anita.

anita: Conditional approval: once PR & JIRA are linked and the scrub is demonstrable (unit test or snippet), I will approve for 48h and we will schedule an automatic deletion job at TTL expiry. :white_check_mark:

security-bot: Note: include `temp_capture` tag in the audit log entry and ensure retention metadata is set to `48h`.

sam: Understood. I'll post links when PR/JIRA are up. Will also include a small sample showing the email mask transformation and the `sha256(user + kms_salt)` call.

anita: Add a disclaimer in PR that no raw tokens or PII should be exported, and add a short runbook for how to handle any unexpected sensitive data we find.

sam: Will do. Thanks all, will update here when done. :rocket:
